newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: CRICKET-AUCKLAND SIGN SRI LANKA'S DA SILVA.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-AUCKLAND SIGN SRI LANKA'S DA SILVA.

text.p: Sri Lankan batsman Aravinda da Silva will play for Auckland in New Zealand's 1996-97 Shell Cup one-day competition, team officials said on Tuesday.
Da Silva, man-of-the-match in the World Cup final victory over Australia earlier this year, will play his first match on December 6 against Central Districts in Napier.

"He's one of the top three or four players in the world right now, a real class act especially in one-day cricket," Auckland Cricket Association chief executive Lindsay Crocker said. "We're satisfied that he'll do the business on the park."
